core-157: Stand tall with the barbell resting on your upper back and hands holding it firmly.
Step one foot back and lower your back knee towards the floor with control.
Keep your torso upright and your front knee in line with your toes.
Push through your front foot to return to standing, then switch legs.
core-163: Set the rope attachment at about face height and hold one end in each hand.
Step back until your arms are straight and stand tall with a steady torso.
Pull the rope towards your face, keeping your elbows high and apart.
Pause briefly, then return slowly without leaning back.
core-164: Stand beside a low, stable bench with a clear landing area.
Bend your knees slightly and swing your arms to prepare.
Hop over the bench and land softly on bent knees.
Reset your balance before the next hop. Choose a non-jumping alternative if needed.
dataset-1373: Stand tall near a wall or rail for balance, feet hip-width apart.
Rise onto the balls of your feet by lifting your heels.
Pause for a moment at the top.
Lower your heels slowly back to the floor.
dataset-0276: Lie on your back with arms pointing up and hips and knees bent at ninety degrees.
Gently press your lower back towards the floor and breathe out.
Slowly extend one arm overhead and the opposite leg forward.
Return to the start and repeat on the other side.
dataset-0289: Lie on a flat, stable bench with feet flat on the floor and a dumbbell in each hand at chest level.
Press the dumbbells up above your chest without locking your elbows.
Lower the dumbbells slowly back to the sides of your chest.
Keep your shoulders and back supported on the bench throughout.
dataset-0293: Hold a dumbbell in each hand and hinge forward at the hips with a slight knee bend.
Keep your back steady and let your arms hang below your shoulders.
Pull the dumbbells towards your hips, squeezing your shoulder blades together.
Lower the dumbbells slowly without swinging.
dataset-0294: Stand tall holding the dumbbells with your arms straight and palms facing forward.
Keep your elbows close to your sides.
Curl the dumbbells up towards your shoulders without swinging your body.
Lower them slowly back to the start.
dataset-3470: Stand tall with your feet hip-width apart.
Take a controlled step forward into a comfortable split stance.
Bend both knees and lower your body, keeping your front heel on the floor.
Push through your front foot to return to standing, then switch legs.
dataset-3013: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat on the floor, arms by your sides.
Lift your hips until your body forms a straight line from shoulders to knees, without arching your lower back.
Lower your hips slowly back to the floor.
dataset-0662: Start in a straight-arm plank with hands slightly wider than your shoulders.
Keep your body in a straight line from head to heels.
Bend your elbows to lower your chest towards the floor.
Press back up to the start. Use a knee or wall push-up if you need an easier version.
dataset-1460: Stand tall in a clear space with your feet together.
Step forward into a lunge, bending both knees with control.
Push through your front foot and bring your back foot forward to stand.
Continue forward, alternating legs at a steady pace.
curated-squat: Stand with your feet about shoulder-width apart and toes slightly turned out.
Push your hips back and bend your knees as if sitting into a chair.
Lower within a comfortable range, keeping your chest up and heels down.
Push through your feet to stand tall again.
curated-barbell-squat: Set the bar in a rack with safety supports at a suitable height.
Rest the bar on your upper back, brace your torso and step back carefully.
Push your hips back and bend your knees to squat to a controlled depth.
Drive through your feet to stand up without rounding your back.
curated-plank: Place your forearms on the floor with elbows under your shoulders.
Step your feet back and rest on your toes.
Keep a straight line from shoulders to heels and tighten your stomach.
Breathe normally and hold for the planned time.
curated-side-plank: Lie on your side with your elbow directly under your shoulder.
Stack your feet or place the top foot in front for balance.
Lift your hips so your body forms a straight line.
Hold while breathing, then change sides.
curated-bird-dog: Start on your hands and knees with hands under shoulders and knees under hips.
Keep your back flat and your hips level.
Slowly extend one arm forward and the opposite leg back.
Return to the start and switch sides.
curated-wall-push: Stand facing a stable wall and place your palms on it at chest height.
Step your feet back a little so your body leans forward in a straight line.
Bend your elbows to bring your chest towards the wall.
Press back to the start with control.
curated-knee-push: Start on your hands and knees, then walk your hands forward until your body is straight from knees to shoulders.
Place your hands slightly wider than your shoulders.
Bend your elbows to lower your chest between your hands.
Press back up without letting your hips sag.
curated-shoulder-press: Sit or stand tall holding a dumbbell beside each shoulder.
Tighten your stomach to keep your back steady.
Press the dumbbells overhead within a comfortable range.
Lower them slowly back to shoulder level.
curated-lateral-raise: Stand tall with light dumbbells at your sides and a soft bend in your elbows.
Raise your arms out to the sides up to about shoulder height.
Pause briefly at the top without shrugging.
curated-band-row: Anchor the band securely at chest height and check it is safe.
Hold the ends and step back until the band is slightly tight.
Pull your elbows back close to your sides, squeezing your shoulder blades.
curated-hip-hinge: Stand with feet hip-width apart and hands on your hips.
Push your hips back while keeping your back straight, letting your torso lean forward.
Bring your hips forward to stand tall without leaning back.
curated-step-up: Stand facing a low, stable step.
Place your whole foot on the step.
Step up with control and bring your other foot up.
Step down slowly one foot at a time, then change the leading leg.
curated-march: Lift one knee gently, then the other, marching in place.
Swing your arms naturally and breathe easily.
Keep the pace comfortable; this is a warm-up.
curated-calf-stretch: Stand facing a wall with your hands on it for support.
Step one foot back and keep that leg straight.
Gently press the back heel towards the floor until you feel a stretch in the calf.
Hold without bouncing, then switch sides.
curated-breathing: Stand or sit comfortably with relaxed shoulders.
Breathe in slowly through your nose.
Continue calmly until your breathing returns to normal.
curated-seated-march: Sit tall near the front of a stable chair or bench with feet flat.
Lift one knee a little while keeping your back upright.
Alternate legs at a steady pace without leaning back.
curated-wall-sit: Stand with your back against a stable wall and feet about a step away from it.
Slide down until your knees are comfortably bent.
Keep your back against the wall and breathe normally.
Hold, then slide back up to stand. Stop if it becomes uncomfortable.
curated-heel-walk: Stand tall next to a stable support.
Lift your heels slightly so you balance on the balls of your feet.
Hold the position steadily without gripping your toes.
Lower your heels slowly when the time is up.
gym-lat-pulldown: Sit at the machine and adjust the thigh pads so your legs are held firmly.
Grip the bar a little wider than your shoulders with palms facing forward.
Lean back slightly, then pull the bar down to your upper chest, driving your elbows down and back.
Let the bar rise slowly until your arms are straight, keeping control.
gym-seated-cable-row: Sit on the bench with feet on the platform and knees slightly bent.
Hold the handle with arms straight and back tall.
Pull the handle to your lower ribs, squeezing your shoulder blades together.
Return slowly until your arms are straight without rounding your back.
gym-triceps-pushdown: Set the cable high and hold the bar or rope with elbows close to your sides.
Stand tall with a slight forward lean and stomach tight.
Push down until your arms are straight, moving only your forearms.
Let your hands rise slowly to about chest height.
gym-pec-deck: Adjust the seat so the handles are at chest height and sit with your back on the pad.
Hold the handles with a slight bend in your elbows.
Bring the handles together in front of your chest in a hugging motion.
Open your arms slowly until you feel a light stretch in the chest.
gym-machine-chest-press: Adjust the seat so the handles line up with the middle of your chest.
Sit with your back flat on the pad and feet on the floor.
Press the handles forward until your arms are nearly straight.
Bring the handles back slowly to chest level.
gym-leg-press: Sit with your back flat on the pad and place your feet hip-width apart in the middle of the platform.
Release the safety handles and hold the side grips.
Bend your knees to lower the platform slowly, keeping your lower back on the pad.
Press the platform away through your whole foot without locking your knees.
gym-leg-extension: Adjust the back pad so your knees line up with the machine's pivot point.
Place the lower pad on the front of your shins, just above the ankles.
Straighten your legs to lift the pad and pause briefly.
Lower slowly back to the start.
gym-lying-leg-curl: Adjust the seat so your knees line up with the machine pivot and lower the thigh pad onto your thighs.
Place the lower pad behind your legs, just above your heels.
Curl your heels down and under the seat while keeping your back on the pad.
Let your legs return slowly until they are almost straight.
gym-barbell-bench-press: Lie on the bench with your eyes under the bar and feet flat on the floor.
Grip the bar a little wider than your shoulders and lift it off the rack with straight arms.
Lower the bar slowly to the middle of your chest, elbows about 45 degrees from your body.
Press the bar back up over your shoulders and rack it safely.
gym-barbell-deadlift: Stand with feet hip-width and the bar over the middle of your feet.
Hinge at the hips and bend your knees to grip the bar just outside your legs.
Brace your stomach, keep your back flat and stand up by pushing the floor away, bar close to your legs.
Lower the bar by pushing your hips back, keeping it close, until it touches the floor.
gym-romanian-deadlift: Stand tall holding the bar at your thighs with hands shoulder-width apart.
Soften your knees and keep your back straight.
Push your hips back and slide the bar down your legs until you feel a stretch in the back of your thighs.
Squeeze your glutes and bring your hips forward to stand tall.
gym-barbell-row: Hold the bar with hands just wider than shoulders and stand tall.
Hinge forward at the hips to about 45 degrees with a flat back and soft knees.
Pull the bar to your lower ribs, squeezing your shoulder blades.
Lower the bar slowly until your arms are straight.
gym-cable-crossover: Set both pulleys high and hold one handle in each hand.
Step forward with one foot for balance, leaning slightly forward.
With a slight bend in your elbows, bring your hands together in front of your chest.
Return slowly until you feel a light stretch in the chest.
home-crunch: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat.
Place your hands lightly beside your head or across your chest.
Breathe out and lift your shoulders off the floor using your stomach muscles.
home-superman: Lie face down with arms stretched forward and legs straight.
Look at the floor to keep your neck long.
Gently lift your arms, chest and legs a little off the floor.
Hold for a moment, then lower slowly.
home-hammer-curl: Stand tall holding dumbbells at your sides with palms facing your body.
Keep your elbows close to your sides.
Curl the dumbbells up toward your shoulders, keeping palms facing in.
home-bench-dips: Sit on the edge of a stable bench or chair and place your hands beside your hips.
Slide your hips off the edge with knees bent and feet flat.
Bend your elbows to lower your body a little, elbows pointing back.
Press up until your arms are straight.
gym-hip-adduction: Set the leg pads wide enough to feel a gentle stretch, then sit with your back against the pad.
Place the inside of your knees against the pads and hold the handles.
Squeeze your legs together in a smooth arc until the pads nearly touch.
Open your legs slowly back to the start without letting the weights touch.
gym-machine-shoulder-press: Adjust the seat so the handles are level with your shoulders.
Sit with your back flat on the pad and grip the handles.
Press the handles straight up until your arms are almost straight.
Lower slowly back to shoulder level and repeat.
gym-assisted-pullup: Choose an assistance weight; a heavier setting gives more help.
Step onto the platform, grip the handles slightly wider than your shoulders and kneel on the pad.
Pull your chest up toward the bar by driving your elbows down.
Lower yourself slowly until your arms are straight, then repeat.
gym-lying-leg-curl-machine: Lie face down with your knees just past the edge of the bench and the pad just above your heels.
Hold the handles and press your hips into the bench.
Curl your heels toward your hips as far as is comfortable.
Lower the pad slowly until your legs are almost straight.
gym-smith-squat: Set the safety stops just below your lowest squat position.
Step under the bar, rest it on your upper back and place your feet slightly in front of you, shoulder-width apart.
Twist the bar to unhook it, then bend your knees and hips to sit down slowly.
Push through your whole foot to stand up, then twist the bar back onto the hooks when finished.
gym-hack-squat: Stand on the platform with your back and shoulders against the pads, feet shoulder-width apart.
Bend your knees and lower slowly while keeping your heels down.
Press back up through your whole foot and lock the safety handles when done.
gym-seated-calf-raise: Sit with the balls of your feet on the platform and the pads resting on your lower thighs.
Raise your heels as high as you can and pause briefly.
Lower your heels slowly below the platform for a gentle stretch, then repeat.
gym-cable-biceps-curl: Attach a straight bar or handle to the low pulley and stand facing the machine.
Hold the bar with palms up, arms straight and elbows close to your sides.
Curl the bar up toward your shoulders without moving your elbows.
Lower slowly until your arms are straight again.
gym-incline-dumbbell-press: Set the bench to a low incline and sit back with a dumbbell on each thigh.
Lie back and bring the dumbbells to the sides of your chest, palms facing forward.
Press the dumbbells up until your arms are almost straight above your chest.
Lower them slowly back to the sides of your chest.
gym-triceps-kickback: Place one knee and one hand on a bench with your back flat.
Hold a dumbbell with your upper arm close to your side and your elbow bent.
Straighten your elbow to move the dumbbell back until your arm is straight.
Bend your elbow slowly to return, then switch arms after the set.
gym-overhead-triceps-extension: Sit or stand tall and hold one dumbbell with both hands above your head.
Keep your elbows pointing forward and close to your head.
Bend your elbows to lower the dumbbell slowly behind your head.
Straighten your arms to lift it back up.
gym-hip-thrust: Sit on the floor with your upper back against a bench and a padded bar over your hips.
Place your feet flat, about hip-width apart, so your shins are vertical at the top.
Drive through your heels to lift your hips until your body is straight from shoulders to knees.
Squeeze your glutes at the top, then lower slowly.
gym-pull-up: Grip the bar slightly wider than your shoulders with palms facing away.
Hang with straight arms and pull your shoulders down.
Pull your chest up toward the bar by driving your elbows down.
Lower yourself slowly until your arms are straight.
gym-rear-delt-raise: Hold light dumbbells and hinge forward at the hips with a flat back.
Let your arms hang below your shoulders with a slight bend in the elbows.
Raise your arms out to the sides until they are level with your shoulders.
gym-barbell-curl: Stand tall holding the bar with palms facing up, hands shoulder-width apart.
Keep your elbows close to your sides.
Curl the bar up toward your shoulders without moving your elbows.
Lower slowly until your arms are straight.
vid-arm-circles: Stand tall with arms straight out to the sides.
Draw small circles, then slowly make them bigger.
Keep shoulders down and breathe steadily.
vid-bicycle-crunch: Lie on your back, hands lightly behind your head.
Bring one knee in and turn the opposite elbow towards it.
Switch sides in a slow pedalling rhythm; do not pull your neck.
vid-butt-kicks: Jog in place on the balls of your feet.
Kick your heels up towards your glutes.
Keep your chest up and arms moving.
vid-high-knees: Run in place, lifting your knees towards hip height.
Land softly on the balls of your feet.
Pump your arms; slow down if you lose your breath.
vid-jumping-jacks: Stand with feet together and arms by your sides.
Jump your feet out while raising your arms overhead.
Jump back in; keep a steady, light rhythm.
vid-mountain-climbers: Start in a high plank, hands under shoulders.
Drive one knee towards your chest, then switch quickly.
Keep your hips level; slow down to stay controlled.
vid-reverse-lunge: Stand tall, then step one foot back.
Lower until both knees are bent, front knee over the ankle.
Push through the front foot to return; switch legs.
vid-reverse-crunch: Lie on your back, knees bent and lifted, arms by your sides.
Curl your hips off the floor, bringing knees towards your chest.
Lower slowly with control; do not swing.
vid-shadow-boxing: Stand in a light boxing stance, hands up by your face.
Throw relaxed straight punches, turning from your hips.
Stay light on your feet and keep breathing.
vid-knee-to-elbow: Stand tall with hands lightly behind your head.
Lift one knee and turn the opposite elbow to meet it.
Alternate sides at a steady pace; no jumping needed.
vid-sumo-squat: Stand with feet wide and toes turned out.
Lower your hips straight down, knees moving over your toes.
Squeeze your glutes to stand back up.
